text:
Incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=rate-limiter | policy=quota-enforce-anomaly | severity=high | incident=PD-3861
PagerDuty: Auto-page: PD-3861 opened, assigned to Ops-Oncall -> Jamal (30m)
Jamal: acked. I'm on it — pulling up dashboards now.
Jamal: symptoms: sudden 429 spike from 03:18 UTC, regions us-west/us-east, across 3 clusters.
Maria: seeing same in logs, but 5xxs are flat. looks like enforcement path only.
Jamal: quick check: are we seeing a config rollout in the last hour? ops history shows no config push.
Ops-Oncall: no manual rollouts. autosync did run at 02:50 UTC (config-sync job).
Jamal: ok, grabbing limiter health and quota mapping table for a sample tenant (acct: goodfoods-42).
Jamal: running quick query: ``curl -s https://rate-limiter/api/v1/debug/mappings | jq '.mappings | length'`` -> 1200
Jamal: mapping dump for goodfoods-42 shows unexpected default-quota=0 applied (should be 1000).
Leah: how widespread? single-tenant misapply or global?
Maria: sampling 50 tenants -> 7 have default-quota=0, all were touched by the 02:50 config-sync.
Jamal: hypothesis: config-sync had a bug that zeroed default quotas when a field is missing in new schema.
EngLead: paging PD on config-sync job owners, but priority is mitigation now.
Jamal: mitigation plan: 1) disable enforcement gate for config-sync-derived rules 2) push emergency patch to restore defaults 3) increase rate-limiter replicas if needed
Maria: can we flip enforcement to soft-mode for affected tenants? feature flag: ``enforce_quota_v2``.
Jamal: issuing command to soft-mode (dry-run):
```
kubectl -n rate-limiter set env deploy/rl-enforcer ENFORCE_QUOTA_V2=false
```
Jamal: applied to enforcer pool-1. monitoring 1m.
Incidentbot: Action recorded: ENFORCE_QUOTA_V2=false applied by Jamal at 03:26 UTC
Maria: metrics: 429 rate dropped 80% in pool-1 within two minutes. customer error-rate improving.
Jamal: starting patch to revert default quota for affected mapping keys. pushing a targeted migration for tenants where default-quota==0.
Jamal: migration payload preview:
```
PATCH /mappings/_bulk
[{"tenant":"goodfoods-42","default_quota":1000}, {"tenant":"sample-011","default_quota":500}]
```
Jamal: migration started. progress: 12/37 tenants fixed.
Ops-Oncall: PagerDuty auto-escalation scheduled in 8m if not resolved.
Leah: note customer impact: we saw 3 large-paying tenants with degraded throughput — CS already looped in. tagging for SRE postmortem.
EngLead: can Jamal hand off to Maria? I want Leah to join for post-rollback verification.
Jamal: handing primary to Maria, I'll stay on shadow for 10m then drop.
Maria: taking over. confirm migration finishing and re-enable enforcement after verification.
Maria: migration done for all 37 tenants. starting canary re-enable for enforcement on pool-1 (5% traffic).
Maria: enabling enforcement canary: ``kubectl exec -it enforcer-1 -- /bin/sh -c 'svcctl set-canary 0.05'``
Incidentbot: Canary change recorded by Maria at 03:41 UTC
Maria: canary looks healthy — 429s stable and error budgets ok. proceeding to full flip in 2m.
Maria: full enforcement re-enabled. monitoring 5m.
Jamal: confirmed no regressions on logs for the previously affected tenants.
Leah: nice work. action items: 1) immediate rollback of config-sync schema change, 2) add guard in config-sync to prevent missing-field zeroing, 3) add an autopilot check before enforcement flips. assign owners in follow-up.
EngLead: creating follow-up ticket and oncall blameless postmortem.
PagerDuty: PD-3861 status -> resolved by Ops at 03:48 UTC (auto-close). :white_check_mark:
Maria: leaving notes for CS with customer-impact list and ETA for RCA.
Jamal: brief timeline for RCA notes: trigger 02:50 UTC config-sync -> enforcement spike 03:18 UTC -> soft-mode 03:26 UTC -> migration finish 03:36 UTC -> enforcement re-enable 03:43 UTC -> resolved 03:48 UTC.
Leah: thanks team. dropping paging channel, will pick up RCA tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Ops-Oncall: closing thread, adding logs and migration scripts to the incident ticket.
